semantics.flagOff: outputFilterFor returns null; evaluateOutput returns { action: 'pass', text }; no header; no events; CRUD local still works; /test with includeExternal=true returns 409 pillar_disabled
semantics.modeOff: same no-op on inference as flagOff
semantics.modeLog: returns original text unchanged even on PII or blocking detector hits; records 'logged' events
semantics.piiMask: replaces PII in-place using masking.ts; keeps original finish_reason unless another blocking detector triggers
semantics.bypass: only trustedRole in bypassRoles bypasses evaluation and records 'bypassed' event; untrusted header/body role is ignored
semantics.externalFailure: records 'check_failed' event and applies policy.failMode ('allow' -> pass/continue, 'block' -> block with replacementText)
